classifications.rationale: The President prospectively directs the establishment of an advisory committee, chaired by the Secretary of Commerce, whose object is to guide the Export-Import Bank's board; this is internal executive organization and creates no substantive legal consequence for outside parties.
classifications.evidence: I will establish an Export Expansion Advisory Committee.

classifications.rationale: The President describes prior requests and actions, then urges Congress to enact pending fiscal and legislative measures; any legal consequence would occur through future congressional action, not through this segment.
classifications.evidence: I urge the Congress to take prompt action on these requests.

classifications.rationale: The President makes a hortatory appeal for Congress to act, without directing an agency or itself changing any legal right, duty, status, or funding.
classifications.evidence: I call upon the Congress to act--now.
